pairs: Habitaverunt autem principes populi in Jerusalem:
Now the leaders of the people lived in Jerusalem. Yet truly,
the remainder of the people cast lots,
ut tollerent unam partem de decem qui habitaturi essent in Jerusalem civitate sancta,
so that they might choose one part in ten who were to live in Jerusalem, the holy city,
and nine parts for the other cities.
Benedixit autem populus omnibus viris qui se sponte obtulerant ut habitarent in Jerusalem.
Then the people blessed all the men who freely offered themselves to live in Jerusalem.
Hi sunt itaque principes provinciæ qui habitaverunt in Jerusalem,
And so these are the leaders of the province, who were living in Jerusalem,
and in the cities of Judah.
Habitavit autem unusquisque in possessione sua,
Now each one lived in his possession, in their cities:
and the sons of the servants of Solomon.
Et in Jerusalem habitaverunt de filiis Juda,
And in Jerusalem, there lived some of the sons of Judah,
and some of the sons of Benjamin:
omnes hi filii Phares, qui habitaverunt in Jerusalem,
All these sons of Perez lived in Jerusalem,
Now these are the sons of Benjamin:
et Joël filius Zechri præpositus eorum,
And Joel, the son of Zichri, was their foremost leader.
et Judas filius Senua super civitatem secundus.
And Judah, the son of Hassenuah, was second over the city.
there were Jedaiah, the son of Joiarib,
the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God,
et fratres eorum facientes opera templi:
and their brothers, who were doing the works of the temple:
And Adaiah, the son of Jeroham,
and his brothers, the leaders among the fathers:
And Amassai, the son of Azarel,
and their brothers, who were very powerful:
et præpositus eorum Zabdiel filius potentium.
And their foremost leader was Zabdiel, the son of the powerful.
there were Shemaiah, the son of Hasshub,
super omnia opera quæ erant forinsecus in domo Dei,
who were over all the works which were exterior to the house of God,
from among the leaders of the Levites.
And Mattaniah, the son of Mica,
princeps ad laudandum et ad confitendum in oratione,
was the leader of praise and confession in prayer,
et Becbecia secundus de fratribus ejus,
with Bakbukiah, second among his brothers,
and Abda, the son of Shammua,
omnes Levitæ in civitate sancta ducenti octoginta quatuor.
All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred eighty-four.
Et reliqui ex Israël sacerdotes et Levitæ in universis civitatibus Juda,
And the remainder of Israel, the priests and the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah,
each one in his own possession.
And the temple servants were living at Ophel,
Et episcopus Levitarum in Jerusalem, Azzi filius Bani,
And the director of the Levites in Jerusalem was Uzzi, the son of Bani,
De filiis Asaph, cantores in ministerio domus Dei.
The singing men in the ministry of the house of God were from the sons of Asaph.
Præceptum quippe regis super eos erat,
In fact, there was a precept of the king about them,
et ordo in cantoribus per dies singulos,
and an order among the singing men, throughout each day.
et Phathahia filius Mesezebel, de filiis Zara filii Juda in manu regis, juxta omne verbum populi,
And Pethahiah, the son of Meshezabel, from the sons of Zerah, the son of Judah, was at the hand of the king concerning every word of the people,
et in domibus per omnes regiones eorum.
and in the houses throughout all their regions.
De filiis Juda habitaverunt in Cariatharbe et in filiabus ejus:
Some of the sons of Judah lived at Kiriatharba and in its daughter villages,
et in Dibon, et in filiabus ejus:
and at Dibon and in its daughter villages,
et in Cabseel, et in viculis ejus:
and at Jekabzeel and in its vicinity,
and at Azekah and in its daughter villages.
Et manserunt in Bersabee usque ad vallem Ennom.
And they dwelt from Beersheba as far as the valley of Hinnom.
But the sons of Benjamin lived from Geba,
and Bethel and in its daughter villages,
and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.
Et de Levitis portiones Judæ et Benjamin.
And some of the Levites were apportioned with Judah and Benjamin.
